The '''House of Marek''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] family that played a prominent role in the [[Corellian Treaty|formation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Prior to the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kento Marek]] [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Mallie Marek|Mallie]], a fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], despite emotional attachment being [[Jedi Code/Legends|forbidden]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. The couple [[Treason/Legends|deserted]] the Order after Mallie became [[Reproduction/Legends|pregnant]] with Kento's [[Youngling/Legends|child]], fleeing to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] where they welcomed a son&mdash;the young but powerful [[Galen Marek]]. In the aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|discovered]] Galen and, sensing the boy's potential, abducted him after [[Death/Legends|murdering]] his [[Parent/Legends|father]].

Bestowing the [[Callsign/Legends|code name]] of "Starkiller" on Galen, Vader spent [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[Sith training|training]] his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] in the [[Code of the Sith/Legends|ways]] of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. Although the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] forbade him from taking a student while still apprenticed to a [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]], Vader encouraged Starkiller to grow stronger with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] so that they could overthrow [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]&mdash;the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] and reigning [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]]. Starkiller longed to become a true Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]], believing it was his destiny to rule the galaxy at Vader's side as the Dark Lord's apprentice. After Vader betrayed Starkiller, the former Sith [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] embraced his Jedi heritage and [[Battle on Death Star I|saved]] the nascent Rebel Alliance at the cost of his life. As a result, the Rebels adopted the [[Alliance Starbird|Marek family crest]] as their official emblem.

Despite the death of Galen Marek, his family's bloodline was preserved through a generation of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] engineered from his [[DNA/Legends|genetic code]] at the behest of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader, who endeavored to create a [[Dark Apprentice|more powerful and obedient version]] of his former apprentice. In attempting to perfect the process of cloning a [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Clone template/Legends|template]], the initial [[Aberrant clone|clones of Marek]] were deformed and psychologically [[Clone madness|unstable]]. The procedure was gradually stabilized, yielding better results yet each clone experienced an identity crisis caused by the [[Memory flash|memory imprints]] of their progenitor. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a year prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], a [[Subject 1138|renegade clone]] [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|escaped]] from the [[Timira City|cloning facility]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

==History==
===The Secret Apprentice===
{{Quote|The blood of a true Jedi, my blood, runs in your veins.|Kento Marek, to Galen Marek|<ref name="TFUvg" />}}
[[File:Kento_2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Kento Marek was a Jedi Knight who survived the initial execution of Order 66.]]
The first known member of the family was [[Kento Marek]], a member of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] who fathered a son, Galen, with his wife, [[Mallie Marek|Mallie]], also a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Kento first met Mallie when both serving as [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi officers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Despite the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code's]] restrictions against attachments and emotional bonds, the two fell in love. After marrying in secret, the two discreetly left the Jedi Order to start a new life together.<ref name="SWDB_Starkiller">{{DB|character|starkiller|Starkiller (Darth Vader's Secret Apprentice)}}</ref>

After exiling themselves and traveling from system to system, Kento and Mallie became fugitives&mdash;along with rest of their former Jedi comrades&mdash;once [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] had been issued. As the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] executed a [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|systematic extermination]] of the remaining Jedi, the Marek family sought to create a safe haven for themselves on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Upon their arrival, they were welcomed by the native [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] who were sympathetic to the persecuted Jedi Order, thus allowing the Mareks to establish a more permanent home on the Wookiee homeworld.<ref name="SWDB_Starkiller" />

The House of Marek lived on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] for roughly ten years. During their time on the Wookiee homeworld, Mallie became pregnant and gave birth to [[Galen Marek]]&mdash;a prodigy of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Even at a very young age, Galen was abnormally [[Force-sensitive/Legends|strong]] in the Force, far more [[Force power/Legends|powerful]] than both of his parents. Not long after Galen's birth, Mallie was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] while protecting a group of Wookiees. At some point during the Great Jedi Purge, while Galen was still a young child, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] personally oversaw an [[Battle of Kashyyyk (c. 18 BBY)|Imperial assault]] on Kashyyyk after learning of the Jedi presence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Kento made his last stand in front of his hut, but was ultimately slain in front of his son by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]].<ref name="SWDB_Starkiller" />

Upon discovering Kento's son, Darth Vader was genuinely shocked that a child could possess an immensely powerful connection to the Force at such a young age, much like himself in the past. After a moment of hesitation, Vader took the boy into his custody and secretly [[Sith training|trained]] him as a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]], thus violating the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]]. Galen, known only to a select few by the codename "Starkiller," overcame one brutal trial after another in order to perfect his role as Vader's personal [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]]. At the same time, his childhood memories became repressed and ultimately forgotten as he became increasingly immersed within the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="TFUvg" /><ref name="TFUn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'' novelization]]</ref>

As Starkiller, the young "Sith" aspirant executed many assassination missions for his [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]] over the years, which eventually led to Jedi targets such as [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]], [[Kazdan Paratus]] and [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]. Nevertheless, his steadfast loyalty was eventually rewarded with Vader's treachery after [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], publicly known as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine, "discovered" Starkiller's existence. Upon learning that his "death" was faked in order to deceive the Emperor, Starkiller remained loyal to Vader while carrying out his greatest task&mdash;the formation of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Even though the mission caused him to develop certain doubts about himself and his Master, Starkiller remained dedicated to his belief in the ultimate goal that he had long since been prepared for; to become a true Sith Lord upon the Emperor's death.<ref name="TFUvg" /><ref name="TFUn" />

[[File:SecretApprentice-TFU.png|thumb|right|200px|Galen Marek, son of Kento Marek, was Darth Vader's secret apprentice, codenamed Starkiller.]]
His faith in Vader was again misplaced when the Dark Lord betrayed him for a second time after Starkiller succeeded in bringing the Empire's most significant enemies together on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Enraged at yet another betrayal, Starkiller dropped his codename in favor of his birth name, Galen Marek, which he rediscovered from repressed memories during his last mission for Vader. Galen's eventual conversion to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi way]] and the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]] was made possible by certain factors&mdash;Vader's betrayals, his remembrance of certain moments in his forgotten life on Kashyyyk, and mostly his growing affection for [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]].<ref name="TFUvg" /><ref name="TFUn" />

Galen's liberation from his role as Vader's secret apprentice would not last long. In an attempt to rescue the Alliance leaders from execution, he journeyed to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|incomplete Death Star]] and [[Battle on Death Star I|confronted]] his former master. Darth Vader ultimately proved to be no match for his younger and more powerful disciple. Although he was initially tempted to kill Vader and take his place at Sidious's side, Galen chose to reject the darkness and fought the Emperor for the lives of his allies. In a selfless act of sacrifice, Galen Marek surrendered his own life to provide the Alliance leaders with enough time to escape from the Death Star, thus ending Kento Marek's bloodline with the death of the last scion of the Marek family.<ref name="TFUvg" /><ref name="TFUn" />

Marek's sacrifice not only ensured the survival of the Rebellion's founders, but also inspired other dissidents to take up arms against the seemingly invincible Galactic Empire. At the behest of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], an [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial senator]] from [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], the Marek family crest was converted into the [[Alliance Starbird]]; a symbol of hope for countless Rebels to rally around in their struggle against the Empire.<ref name="TFUvg" /><ref name="TFUn" />

===Starkiller's clones===
{{Quote|You were cast from the mold of a dead man. You have inherited his skills, but also his weaknesses.|Darth Vader, to the Dark Apprentice|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
[[File:Starkiller_clones.png|thumb|left|250px|Vader's efforts to clone his deceased apprentice resulted in numerous failed copies.]]
Despite the death of Galen Marek, his family's bloodline was ultimately preserved by his former Master's attempts to replicate a more powerful and loyal version of Starkiller. Deep within a [[Timira City|cloning facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Darth Vader initiated a clandestine operation dedicated to creating a perfect and stable [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of his fallen apprentice.<ref name="TFUII" /> Though the "accelerated cloning process"&mdash;an advanced but experimental version of the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] method of cloning&mdash;enabled Vader to engineer a clone to full maturity in a matter of weeks, the process was consistently undermined by setbacks such as physical deformities and [[Clone madness|psychological instability]].<ref name="TFU2c">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> As a result, the initial tests yielded poor results; the [[Aberrant clone|first series]] of the Marek clones were deformed and insane.<ref name="Databank">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' in-game databank</ref> The project was further complicated by the inherent difficulties of cloning [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]].<ref name="TFU2n">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref>

As the cloning process was gradually refined, new clones of Galen Marek were created with more stability than their precursors. But even these improved test subjects were destabilized as each clone succumbed to madness, brought on by the [[Memory flash|memory imprints]] of their progenitor. This form of [[flash training]] caused the clones to experience a sense of identity crisis, and thus they adopted certain characteristics of Marek's personality. While some clones were affected by memories of Marek's father, others were disturbed by recollections of the young boy whom Marek once was during his time on Kashyyyk. At least one clone was known to have been influenced by Marek's attachment to his droid PROXY. Overall, however, many of these clones' training was personally overseen by Darth Vader, who judged them all to be failures.<ref name="TFU2n" />

[[File:Starkiller_Cato_Neimoidia.png|thumb|right|250px|A renegade clone escaped from Kamino and ultimately joined the Rebel Alliance.]]
After a long line of failures, Darth Vader hoped to finally find success with [[Subject 1138]],<ref name="TFU2 website">{{LucasArts|url=games/theforceunleashed2|text=''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II''}}</ref> a clone of Galen Marek who progressed far into his training enough to impress the Sith Lord.<ref name="TFUII" /> In order to discover if the clone was able to free himself from the influence of Marek's memories, Vader ordered him to destroy several [[Sith Training Droid|training droids]] disguised as [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]]. Unlike his template, the clone spared no feelings for the Rebel Alliance that Galen Marek helped to create. Yet even though he attacked them without hesitation, he could not bring himself to strike down a droid disguised as Juno Eclipse. As with the other failed subjects, this clone was incapable of rejecting all of the imprinted emotions of his progenitor. While he personally cared nothing for Marek's deceased parents or the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]], he could not discard his genetically inherited feelings for Eclipse.<ref name="TFU2n" />

When Vader declared him to be another failed subject like the rest who came before, the clone turned against his creator and [[Escape from Kamino (1 BBY)|fled]] from Kamino. Utterly fixated on the Human woman whom Marek fell in love with, the clone embarked on a single-minded journey to locate Eclipse. During his quest, he subsequently became known as "Starkiller", the former codename of Galen Marek during his time as Vader's secret apprentice.<ref name="TFUII" /> The clone, however, refused to acknowledge his template's codename&mdash;and especially Marek's birth name&mdash;as his own. From the clone's point of view, the names "Starkiller" and "Galen Marek" belonged to a different man.<ref name="TFU2n" />

Although Darth Vader made the recapture of the renegade clone a high priority, he continued to concentrate his efforts into creating a single perfect clone of Galen Marek; a clone who was fit to stand at his side as a Sith apprentice. There were still other clones to choose from, including [[Subject 1157]]. Despite the "[[Force vision/Legends|hallucinations]]" he suffered and his rejection of the memory imprints, a [[Unidentified cloning technician|cloning technician]] noted that Subject 1157's development was very remarkable, especially in comparison to the failures who preceded him. At this time, however, Subject 1157 was still being developed within a [[cloning tank]] and had to be regularly sedated because of his increasingly volatile temperament.<ref name="TFU2 website" />

[[File:Dark_Apprentice_DT.png|thumb|left|180px|Only one of Galen's clones fulfilled the conditions required to become Vader's new apprentice.]]
Unknown to Starkiller, [[Dark Apprentice|another clone]] had been activated and tested through a variety of trials. Though he was originally confused and distracted by the memory imprints, including the ones of Juno Eclipse, the clone steadily strengthened his resolve as he continuously passed one test after another. As his success continued, the clone was made aware of his deceased progenitor's failings, as well as the failings of his cloned brethren who were unable to meet Darth Vader's expectations. Determined to not be just another disappointment in a long line of failed test subjects, the clone persevered in his trials in order to prove his worthiness.<ref name="DT">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'': "Distant Thunder" cutscenes</ref> The [[Lead Cloning Technician|lead cloning technician]] who oversaw his development was astonished by the clone's stability. The technician was pleased to discover that the clone compartmentalized his template's memories, which thus allowed him to separate the imprints from his own experiences.<ref name="Databank" /> The clone, unaffected by the identity crisis that undermined his precursors, was able to progress farther than any of those who came before him.<ref name="DT" />

As Darth Vader became more impressed with his latest test subject, the Sith Lord eventually judged the clone to be worthy enough to see the proof of his origin. Vader brought the clone into a cold chamber, located in Timira City, that contained the preserved corpse of Galen Marek. The clone, freed from the influence of Marek's memories, was unaffected by the revelation of what he already knew to be true: he was a clone and the real Starkiller was dead. By this time, the clone had become his own individual, a person who deeply hated his former self for the weaknesses that made him unfit to be a Sith. By the time of the [[Assault on Kamino]], Darth Vader regarded the clone&mdash;who had become utterly immersed within the dark side of the Force&mdash;as his "Dark Apprentice"; the only perfect clone of the original Starkiller.<ref name="DT" />
